name: Frosthowl
objectiveText: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village. Sack of Fish  ( 1 )

comments.body: he's at the end of the cave directly west from kharanos. coords 42, 54
replies: For clarity, this is the Wendigo cave.

comments.body: Depending on your level and class choice, you may want to group up for this one. Frosthowl [b]has more health[/b] than the other yetis, he [b]hits harder[/b] and he even [b]Rejuvenates himself[/b]. I found myself going out of mana fighting him, and with no wand, I couldn't finish the kill at level 7.

This quest bugged when I looted Sack of Fish and wouldn't award any quest progress. A full relog will fix this. It seems to occur with people in a party where not everyone gets the item to drop on the first kill. Not sure if its intended to be this way or not so have submitted a bug report just in case.
I hate the placement of this quest. it would be beneficial to grab this BEFORE hitting up kharanos. Otherwise you end up running through a cave that you've already been through again for 1 quest.
